title: Reference approach: Export Validation
answer: Implement export validation in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: torch.export.export, torch.export.save, torch.export.load, assert_close. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 143. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
model=nn.Linear(4,2).eval(); example=torch.randn(3,4); exported=torch.export.export(model,(example,)); exported_out=exported.module()(example)
with torch.inference_mode(): reference=model(example)
torch.testing.assert_close(exported_out,reference); print(exported_out.shape)
